shortDescription: NetApp E-Series manage iSCSI target configuration

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API. Example https://prod-1.wahoo.acme.com/devmgr/v2

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: chap_secret
options.description: Enable Challenge-Handshake Authentication Protocol (CHAP), utilizing this value as the password. When this value is specified, we will always trigger an update (changed=True). We have no way of verifying whether or not the password has changed. The chap secret may only use ascii characters with values between 32 and 126 decimal. The chap secret must be no less than 12 characters, but no greater than 57 characters in length. The chap secret is cleared when not specified or an empty string.

options.name: log_path
options.description: A local path (on the Ansible controller), to a file to be used for debug logging.

options.name: name
options.description: The name/alias to assign to the iSCSI target. This alias is often used by the initiator software in order to make an iSCSI target easier to identify.

options.name: ping
options.description: Enable ICMP ping responses from the configured iSCSI ports.

options.name: ssid
options.description: The ID of the array to manage. This value must be unique for each array.

options.name: unnamed_discovery
options.description: When an initiator initiates a discovery session to an initiator port, it is considered an unnamed discovery session if the iSCSI target iqn is not specified in the request. This option may be disabled to increase security if desired.
